tagline: A capital of islands — culture, leisure and wildlife, all separated by water.
summary: Abu Dhabi is built across an archipelago: the CBD island, Saadiyat's cultural district, Yas leisure, Lulu, the mangroves and the far wildlife islands. Almost every premium journey wants to be a short water hop, and the outer luxury islands have no fast, clean link at all.

use_cases.title: Cultural-island shuttle
use_cases.body: A fast, smooth Corniche ↔ Saadiyat ↔ Yas ↔ Lulu network turns a fragmented archipelago into a single connected visitor experience.

use_cases.title: Sir Bani Yas wildlife corridor
use_cases.body: The far luxury islands are the natural long-range hybrid anchor — a clean, single-leg link from the capital and from Dubai, with no charging infrastructure offshore.

use_cases.title: ADGM business shuttle
use_cases.body: A repeatable corporate service from the financial district to Saadiyat and the resort cluster — premium, predictable, zero-emission.

use_cases.title: Capital marine network
use_cases.body: A premium foiling layer that links the island districts and decarbonizes intra-capital water transport for the integrated transport authority.

use_cases.title: In-app island hops
use_cases.body: On-demand premium water trips between islands, booked in-app — the same super-app water tier as the wider Gulf.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Sheltered island-to-island hops (Corniche, Saadiyat, Yas, Lulu, mangroves) run all-electric on a single charge — ideal protected first-of-class waters, and zero-wake operation fits the mangrove reserve.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Turns Sir Bani Yas (~135 nm from Dubai), Doha and the wider Gulf into routine single-leg corridors, anchoring the luxury-hospitality opportunity from H2 2026.

signature_routes: Abu Dhabi ↔ Sir Bani Yas (luxury wildlife hybrid)
transit_planning: For the integrated transport authority: a premium zero-emission foiling layer connecting the capital's islands and the cultural district, plus a credible decarbonization path for intra-capital marine modes — additive to existing services and uniquely suited to the protected mangrove waters.

careem.note: Island-hop water tier in-app across the capital archipelago.

aman-hospitality.note: Sir Bani Yas and Saadiyat resort arrivals as the luxury anchor.
